description: This source file contains unit tests for the HostEnvSanitizer utility within the OpenClaw project. The tests verify sanitization and inspection of environment variable overrides, focusing on security and correctness when handling different override scenarios.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests that specific environment variables related to shell tracing and execution are sanitized (removed) as intended.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Verifies that only permitted keys are retained when sanitizing environment variables with a shell wrapper.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Checks that non-shell wrapper sanitization preserves overrides.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Ensures the inspection function correctly flags blocked and invalid keys in overrides.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Tests that Windows-style environment variable keys are accepted and preserved during sanitization.
